lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular blobs organized into approximately four vertical columns, with each column containing 3 to 4 visible spots posterior to the dorsal fin leading edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity blobs are precisely localized at the intersections of light-colored vertical bands and horizontal linear ridges, forming a structured matrix pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible across the mid-to-upper flank, defined by a distinct light-above-dark luminance gradient characteristic of physical ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 4-6 faint, small high-luminance spots, located primarily on the mid-to-posterior section of the fin's surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or irregular truncation is visible at the apex of the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
